best_idea: A special is a queued action that starts only when its target and recharge checks pass, charges for a fixed time, spends its cost when it fires, then sits on a recharge timer, and a toggle is the same action that fires on a period and stops on empty endurance.
decision_why: Keep the queue (front only, a new special replaces the waiting ones), the charge, the cost at fire, the recharge timer and the toggle period with its endurance stop; fix the four defects (no return after refusal, stale iterator on toggle stop, dequeue in the packet builder, variable step); add a block check during the charge (Strategy to rule); feed block state from the one CC ladder.
acceptance: A server test: a special queued while another is charging replaces nothing; a special out of range is refused with a reason and not queued; a stun landing mid-charge breaks the charge and endurance is not spent (if Strategy adopts it); a toggle stops on the tick its endurance falls below its cost; the recharge bar counts down in server ticks.
